# A left-labelled field squeezes its input to show an error

Sub of #21329. Owned by @neo-opus-ada for the Engine 14 cut (Mon 23 Nov), so no curated labels: #21376's field workbenches show an invalid state for every field type, so every left-labelled stage shows this.

## Context

Measured on `dev` `fe695ca1cf` in devmode, `examples/form/field/text`, with the live field set through `Neo.worker.App.setConfigs` to `showCharacterCount: false`, `labelPosition: 'left'`, `labelWidth: 120`, `width: 360`:

| State | Field `display` | Input | Error |
|---|---|---|---|
| no error | flex, 27 px high | 216 px wide | none |
| `error: 'Min length violation: 2 / 3'` | flex, 27 px high | **92 px** wide | beside the input, same row (x 373–497) |

With a character count the same field already shows the error on a row of its own. The earlier sighting: defect-note `b00ffbbe` (18 Nov 14:02Z, `examples/form/field/email` at 200 px: a 50 px input beside "Not a valid email address"). #21324 and #21329 left it out of scope as a layout decision for every text field. This ticket takes that decision.

## The Problem

`Neo.form.field.Text` lays out as one flex row, `[label][input][error wrapper]`, with a fixed height. An in-flow error becomes a third item in that row and takes its width from the input, down to the input's 50 px `min-width`. The field the user is correcting shrinks at the moment they need it.

## The Architectural Reality

- `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css`: `.neo-textfield` is `display: flex` with `height: calc(var(--textfield-input-height) + var(--textfield-border-width) * 2)`. `&.neo-has-character-count` switches to a grid, `"label input" ". counter" ". error"`, with variants for right, top, bottom and inline labels and `height: max-content`.
- `src/form/field/Text.mjs`: the error wrapper is in the DOM only while an error shows (`errorWrapper.removeDom = !value`). `errorPositionAbsolute` adds `.neo-absolute` to `.neo-textfield-error`, which takes it out of the flow.
- `resources/css/src/form/field/TextArea.css` adjusts the textarea under `:has(.neo-textfield-error)`; `resources/css/src/form/field/Chip.css` gives the inline-labelled chip field a grid of its own with an error row.

Design authority: PR #20311 (#3935) — the character-count grid puts the error on its own row under the input column, for every label position. No record keeps the in-row error for a field without a counter; #21324 deferred the choice.

## The Fix

In `resources/css/src/form/field/Text.css`, a field showing an in-flow error takes the same grid as a field with a counter: the grid rule's selector becomes `&.neo-has-character-count, &:has(> .neo-textfield-error-wrapper > .neo-textfield-error:not(.neo-absolute))`. No JavaScript changes: the DOM already says whether an in-flow error shows.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A left- or right-labelled field showing an in-flow error keeps its input's width, and the error sits below the input, starting at the input's left edge.
- [ ] AC-2: Top, bottom and inline labels keep their error below the input, as today.
- [ ] AC-3: A field with `errorPositionAbsolute` keeps its absolute error and its one-row height.
- [ ] AC-4: A field without an error renders as before.
- [ ] AC-5: A browser spec reads the input's width and the error's position with and without an error: red on `dev`, green at head.
- [ ] AC-6: Post-merge: the invalid cells of the field workbenches show the error under the input (the tile pass with #21333).

## Out of Scope

- Error wording and colours.
- The chip field's inline grid (`Chip.css`), which already has its error row.

## Avoided Traps

- Keying the layout on `.neo-invalid`: a field can be invalid without a visible error (before its first validation), and the layout would jump with no message to show.
- A JavaScript class toggle for the same fact the DOM already carries.
